page.layout: One page of text, single column; margin notes right (signature-like marks "III.", "II.", "III." beside lines); a catchword-like "P" and "ἐις" at foot of text; running head "VERBORUM" at top with page number 225.

main_text.p: τὰ μὲν σώματα, συμμέτροις πόνοις· ἡ δὲ ψυχὴ ἀπαθείαις λόγοις, αὔξεται πέφυκεν.
[Observatio. Dativus ejusmodi nonnunquam in Accusativum commutatur. ut:
main_text.head: VI.
main_text.p: Composita cum Præpositionibus, ἐν, εἰς, σὺν, πρὸς, ἀμφὶ, αὐτὶ, ὑπὸ, περὶ, ὑπὲρ, ὑπο, Dativos asciscunt. ut:II.
συγχαίρειν χρὴ τοῖς φίλοις καλῶς πεάθιν, ὡς κ' συναλγὴν λυπημένοις.
[Observatio. Quædam composita cum ἐν & εἰς, etiam cum Accusativo junguntur. ut:III.

page.notes: Greek text is partly damaged and uncertain; several Greek words are doubtful and may be misread. Marginal notes "III.", "II.", "III." are marked at the right edge. The foot "P" and "ἐις" are catchword-like fragments. Left margin is faded with show-through from the reverse page.
